referenceCamera.note: Orthographic-like three-quarter product framing estimated from chassis edge convergence.

objectClass.notes: Three-display articulated computer with armored shells and dense repeated controls.

reasoning: Keyboard, vents, fasteners, light rails and UI graphics are dense repeated systems.
Eight distinct PBR roles are visible.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Visible articulation and repetition require a deep hierarchy.

definitionOfDone: Preserve the three-display silhouette, armored white chassis, pastel mechanical keyboard, front carry handle, rotary control, perimeter lighting, and distinct technical screen interfaces.
Remain volumetric from four cardinal views and expose separately clickable and explodable major assemblies.

featureGroups.name: Three-display articulated silhouette
qualityCriteria: Main lid and two canted wing displays retain reference proportions and negative spaces.

featureGroups.name: Layered armored chassis
qualityCriteria: White chamfered shell, dark seams, corner armor and handle read as separate volumes.

featureGroups.name: Keyboard and control density
qualityCriteria: Individually raised multicolor keys, encoder, nav keys and vent arrays remain legible.

featureGroups.name: Three technical display systems
qualityCriteria: Infinity editor, radar telemetry and wireframe analysis UIs remain distinct.

featureGroups.name: Pearl metal and emissive look development
qualityCriteria: Cool-white clearcoat, navy glass and cyan-violet-magenta bloom reproduce the reference value range.

antiShallowSpecRules: No flat side-screen cards without backing shells.
mustNotDo: Do not claim hidden underside geometry is reference-exact.
Do not alias albedo into roughness or normal channels.
Do not remove named parts to meet performance targets.

featureReviewTargets.name: Main lid plus two canted wing displays
Pastel mechanical keyboard and right control cluster
Infinity editor, radar and engineering UI motifs
Pearl shell, dark glass and RGB practical lighting

silhouette.boundingShape: shallow beveled base, upright main lid, two canted auxiliary wings and projected front handle
silhouette.symmetry: approximately bilateral with asymmetric controls and wing UIs

actionReadiness.contract: Every major assembly is a named pivot, clickable and explodable; hinge pivots and control sockets remain independently addressable.

buildPasses.goal: Lock three-display silhouette and macro proportions.
acceptance: Reference silhouette remains recognizable without materials.

buildPasses.goal: Build independent shells, hinges, keyboard deck and control clusters.
acceptance: No visible macro assembly is fused or floating.

buildPasses.goal: Add chamfers, keys, vents, screws, ports, mounts and encoder.
acceptance: Dense mechanical detail survives the reference camera distance.

buildPasses.goal: Match pearl alloy, dark glass, pastel polymer and emissive accents.
acceptance: PBR response remains distinct under neutral light.

buildPasses.goal: Add edge highlights, ribbing, screen graphics and local roughness variation.
acceptance: Micro details remain tied to inventory evidence.

buildPasses.goal: Match cool studio key, violet rim, bloom and contact shadow.
acceptance: Reference value range and material readability coexist.

buildPasses.goal: Expose selection, explode and screen-power interactions.
acceptance: Picking and explosion share the same named part manifest.

buildPasses.goal: Protect 60 FPS without removing identity geometry.
acceptance: Repeated details use instancing where practical.

proceduralStrategy: BeveledBoxGeometry and extruded chamfered profiles for shells.
Instanced or repeated meshes for keys, vents and screws.
CanvasTexture for the three independent technical displays.
Named pivot groups for lid, wings, handle, encoder and shell assemblies.

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Preserve identity geometry; instance repeated keys, slots and screws.

lodPlan.strategy: hide legends and micro fasteners, preserve three-display silhouette

assumptions: Hidden underside and rear ports use functional symmetry-based inference.
Wing rear shells and hinge interiors are approximate.
Keyboard legends are representative rather than literal.
risks: Single-view perspective may bias wing angle and lid depth.
Whole-object PBR extraction mixes material regions; scalar PBR values and manual visual review remain authoritative.
